en: This is a vintage sepia postcard featuring a large, stately academic-style building surrounded by trees and a balustrade, with people walking in front. The building is labeled in both Bulgarian and German as the 'Varna Handelakademie' (Trade Academy of Varna). One side of the card has handwritten text in Bulgarian, with a Bulgarian stamp, postmark, and address. There are also Cyrillic inscriptions about the sender and recipient.
